title: Highest mountains
measure: Height of the summit above sea level, in metres. Prominence is shown alongside: how far a summit rises above the lowest point you'd have to cross to reach a higher one. It shows which peaks stand on their own and which are shoulders of a bigger neighbour.

entries.name: Everest
entries.note: 8,848.86 m, announced jointly by China and Nepal on 8 December 2020 from GPS and trigonometric surveys by both countries' teams in 2019 and 2020. It's the snow height, 86 cm above the old 8,848 m figure. As the highest point on Earth, its prominence equals its height.
entries.source: Associated Press and Al Jazeera, 8 December 2020; Wikipedia, List of highest mountains

entries.name: Lhotse
entries.note: Joined to Everest by the South Col, so it rises only 610 m above it. Fourth highest, but barely a separate mountain.

entries.name: Cho Oyu
entries.note: Some sources give 8,201 m. Either way it stays sixth.

entries.name: Nanga Parbat
entries.note: The most prominent peak in the top 10 after Everest: it stands almost alone at the western end of the Himalaya.
